reason: The commit changes input-driven RAR PPMd decoding internals without adding an entry point, API protocol, required state, configuration, or separate input channel. H0 already enables all formats and filters, opens mutated archive bytes through archive_read_open_memory, and repeatedly invokes archive_read_next_header and archive_read_data_block, which reaches the changed RAR decoding path with attacker-controlled archive contents. The new ppmd_escape field and escape codes in read_data_compressed remain controlled by the same archive byte stream parsed by parse_codes, so no material harness gap is introduced or aggravated.
evidence: H0 supplies mutated image bytes and size directly to archive_read_open_memory(a, image, size).
H0 drives decompression by looping over archive_read_next_header(a, &ae) and archive_read_data_block(a, &blk, &blk_size, &blk_offset).
H0 includes multiple compressed RAR seeds, including test_read_format_rar_compress_best.rar, test_read_format_rar_compress_normal.rar, and test_read_format_rar_multi_lzss_blocks.rar.
The changed parse_codes derives ppmd_flags, dictionary_size, and ppmd_escape from the RAR bitstream.
The changed read_data_compressed handles Ppmd7_DecodeSymbol results and emits literals or matches through the existing data-read operation.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit; retain H0's existing RAR archive mutation and data-block traversal.
